finding: Calling aws___search_documentation on the AWS Knowledge MCP endpoint, keyless and with the same argument that the unprefixed search_documentation was refused for 28 seconds earlier, answered HTTP 200 with real ranked AWS documentation and isError false. This is the control that makes the sibling finding a finding about NAMES rather than about a broken or key-gated tool: this prefixed tool works for an anonymous caller, so the refusal of the unprefixed name is about the name. The claim is about this one tool. The four other prefixed names tools/list advertises were called separately on 2026-10-01 and have their own records (p-20261001-aws-knowledge-mcp-list-regions-keyless, p-20261001-aws-knowledge-mcp-regional-availability-keyless, p-20261001-aws-knowledge-mcp-read-documentation-keyless and p-20261001-aws-knowledge-mcp-retrieve-skill-keyless); this record asserts nothing about them. It is filed as its own record because a probe is one request; the record it controls names it by id.
